name: interface-lineage
description: Query the Interface Lineage corpus over MCP — dissected interfaces, design principles, people, and the typed lineage between them — with skills for exploring a design's lineage, citing sources, and reading the edge vocabulary. Grounded answers from live examples instead of averaged-out training data.

api_token.title: Interface Lineage token
api_token.description: Personal MCP token from https://interfacelineage.com/account. Sign-in is by email, no password, and every account gets a token free. Reading the archive in a browser needs no account; the tools need this token, and refuse without it.
